headline: Template administrator and employee contracts, medical reserve, unbudgeted items, and several school policy changes.
summary: The meeting covers template contracts for administrators and employees, plus finance items including the medical reserve. Policy items include student activity accounts, service and therapy animals, community flyers, harassment, network use, and hiring.
items: Contract and compensation for administrators CDD
Approve distribution of community flyers policy
Amend GBEBD employee network and internet policy
Policy manual grammatical and formatting edit review
location: Pawtucket School Department Administration, 286 Main St, Pawtucket, RI 02860
